title: Introduce policy-enforcer service for tenant geo-affinity, KMS assertions, and immutable audit anchors
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds a new policy-enforcer microservice that validates tenant KMS region affinity, enforces immutable audit anchors, and applies per-tenant retention labels; includes a shadow-mode rollout and a feature flag for gradual enforcement; adds observability metrics and health checks; no customer-facing API change.
description: Motivation: customers require stronger guarantees that tenant data is processed with the correct regional KMS keys and that audit headers are immutable for compliance audits. This PR introduces a lightweight policy-enforcer service that centralizes enforcement of tenant geo-affinity, KMS region assertions, and audit-anchor immutability while integrating with RBAC v2 attribute checks. Changes: 1) new microservice 'policy-enforcer' implemented in Go with gRPC and HTTP health endpoints; 2) policy evaluation engine that uses tenant profile configs (tenant.kms_region, tenant.retention_class) and RBAC v2 attribute checks to return allow/deny decisions; 3) middleware for the API gateway to call policy-enforcer in shadow mode by default and optional strict mode behind feature flag 'policy_enforcer.enabled'; 4) audit-anchor sanitizer that rejects or signs conflicting audit headers and emits signed audit anchors to audit-proxy; 5) migration tool to backfill tenant policy profiles from existing KMS metadata; 6) Kubernetes manifests, Helm chart updates, and rollout plan; 7) unit and integration tests, and an observability dashboard. Deployment plan: land on main in shadow mode, run for 2 weeks with sampling and alerting for rejects, promote to strict for targeted tenants via Linear ENG-2045, then enable global strict mode if no regressions. Rollback: disable 'policy_enforcer.enabled' or scale the deployment to zero; graceful fail-open config available. Checklist: - [x] core policy engine implemented and unit-tested - [x] gateway middleware added and exercised locally - [x] migration tool with dry-run - [x] integration tests covering KMS region mismatch and audit header tampering - [x] metrics + dashboard - [x] docs and runbook written - [x] security review done. Testing notes: integration tests run against local KMS simulator and mock RBAC server; CI shows full test matrix passing. Impact: expected small increase in API latency when running in strict mode for first request per tenant due to policy cache warmup; batching of policy checks implemented to minimize overhead.
commits: feat: add policy-enforcer service and basic engine; feat: gateway middleware and config; test: add integration suite and migration tool; chore: helm chart and docs; fix: address reviewer edge-case for audit signing
